metadata.boundary: Exclusive disposable non-production runtime surface for T003 cutover-readiness rehearsal. Before any block-device or boot effect, the sandbox materializes and verifies a content-addressed immutable whole-source snapshot from the exact reviewed Heim-PC Git revision selected after T001, T002, T004 and T005 are terminal, binding Git commit/tree plus the reviewed Control Release Set/lock identity. Rebuild, reconstruction and boot consume only that sandbox-owned snapshot; after binding, no mutable /home/alex/repos/heim-pc checkout, branch, lock or unpinned remote source may participate. The sandbox may expose a blank virtual block device and disposable restore scratch only after fresh evidence proves that the backing target is not the productive Heim-PC root/system disk, not any mounted production filesystem and not production EFI/firmware state. Independent off-host backup material may be consumed read-only for restore testing but grants no production-device write authority.
does_not_establish: production EFI or firmware mutation authority
production NixOS install or activation authority
